decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a cheap variant of the core offer that still matches bathroom design trends, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspirations to prompt dropping it.

The pump-assisted line is further from the core and its results remain uncertain, but the firm's slack and the related 2024 pump-drain channel suggest management is building this renovation niche rather than abandoning it.
The stainless steel design grate fits the design-led positioning and uses the firm's own metal manufacturing at little extra cost, so with no performance shortfall it stays.
The newly launched pump-drain shower channel has its own page and supports barrier-free bathroom architecture, so it needs time to show results and the firm's slack lets it carry the product.
